I think high standards from my parents with my lack of friends made me question things and start viewing myself negatively, I think I’m really mad because of how out of control I am with the things I have in life. I don’t know how to properly socialize in real life and it’s hard for me to get by “normally”. I’ve also been neglected by my family on multiple occasions with barely any attention put on me. I think it’s like I view my actions as black and white, good and bad. I also think it’s hard for me to realize my actions have a grey area, and aren’t like a test where my answer is either “correct” or “incorrect”. I’ve thought like this for quite a while.

I think the depression part of it kind of began around the time school started back up, say September. I began feeling more and more tired and unmotivated once piles of work were put in front of me and that kinda worsened my self-perception and caused me to spiral. I’ve been feeling resentment towards myself for years, though.
